text:
This is a big finding.

Omar and his team have been working on this line of research (e.g., DSPy) for the past couple of years. To be honest, I had always been skeptical about his approach of using LLMs to optimize LLMs. It was in my view borrowing Matei Zaharia's research - Matei is Omar's PhD advisor, also the CTO of Databrick - in big data (compiler optimization etc.) and forcing it to LLM systems. Along with some other projects from James Zou at Stanford etc. that build upon the same line of intuition.

Now, if this new result holds, I believe it's a huge deal for AI research. It means that LLM systems can truly runtime self-optimize/improve/adapt. Congrats to Omar and his team. It really takes year to punch it through and convince the doubters :)
